National Song 'Vande Mataram' Played at Independence Day Event

The national song 'Vande Mataram' was played in full before and after President Droupadi Murmu's address on the 80th Independence Day. The event took place at the Red Fort. Some reports highlighted this as a historic first for the Independence Day celebrations.
